params.prompt: In-game screenshot of a polished stylized 3D action-adventure game set in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul, Korea, inside a small real-life interior. SETTING: the dining hall of the same old gukbap restaurant in the evening rush, about 10 by 8 meters, seen from the entrance. Six square stainless-steel tables each with four round red plastic stools, stainless water cups, a yellow aluminium kettle, little dishes of kimchi and radish, napkin dispensers; cream walls with a long wooden menu board of plain color panels above the pass-through window to the kitchen, an old small flat TV on a wall bracket in a corner, a standing water purifier, a calendar shape, a coat hook row; the warm wood counter with a cash register by the door; fluorescent ceiling panels; a steamed-up glass front door with the dark street outside. A few customers eat: two construction workers in dusty jackets, a student pair. The player character in a black school blazer carries a tray with four bowls, seen from behind. Warm yellow light, steam over the bowls. RENDERING STYLE: cel-shaded 3D that reads like a flat-colored anime background painting. Every surface is a flat color area with exactly one crisp shadow tone (a warm grey multiply of the base color, never black or muddy), thin warm-black ink outlines (#1A1417) on silhouettes, frames, furniture and object edges; outlines get thinner with distance. No gradients on walls, no photographic textures, no realistic dirt: materials are suggested only by sparse hand-drawn marks (a few ink dots, short hatching strokes, tile seams, wood grain lines). Muted low-saturation palette, subtle paper grain over the whole image, gentle split toning. Shapes are clean and readable like a real-time 3D game built from modular pieces, yet rich in lived-in props. CAMERA: third-person game camera, lens height about 1.6 m, 35 mm lens, natural eye-level perspective, the whole room readable. The reference image shows the player character (a lanky 17-year-old Korean boy with curly black hair): draw him small, standing in the lower left third and filling about one third of the image height. No HUD, no UI, no watermark. Posters, boards, menus and labels are simple blocks of color or tiny illegible scribbles: absolutely no readable letters, no Korean or English text, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks anywhere. No alcohol, no cigarettes.
